label: GOD_4 exists, from the owner's definitional argument (P1 and P2, analyst formulation) (inference)
rule: Universal instantiation of P2 at P1's description, modus ponens, then dropping the omnibenevolence conjunct
meaning: The owner-specified definitional argument, analyst formulation with attribution deferred: if the description 'existing, God, omnibenevolent' has been defined (P1) and whatever has been defined is satisfied (P2, weak version), then some being, an object satisfying the frame's existence predicate, is God. The full instance of P2 also gives that this God is omnibenevolent; the bound conclusion is the root node's GodExists read over the frame's beings. Valid. A transcription by instantiation: its whole content is P2 applied to P1's description. P1 and the weak P2 are jointly consistent (retorsion part (d)), but the freedom of stipulation P1 uses also licenses the contrary sole-God definition, under which the weak P2 is contradictory (retorsion part (b)); the unrestricted P2 is logically false (part (a)). So P2 gets no warrant from definitional freedom, and a P2 restricted enough to stay consistent must exclude descriptions for reasons other than their having been defined, as the nuclear reconstruction does. Under the analytic reading of P2 the argument is invalid (analytic-reading countermodel).
